docs/rom/bn4.md:51.title: Enemy records
docs/rom/bn4.md:51.how: Found by the HP read in romlab: battles forced with enemy 1, 3, 5 and 13 alone held 40, 100, 180 and 50 in one RAM word of the enemy's (`0x0203B27C` that time); the one table of the ROM with those at a fixed stride is this one. +0 element << 12 \| HP (BN6's first word's form: VolGear's `0x1050`, Fire, 80), +3 the kind (4 a virus, 8 a Navi), +4 the family or the Navi's number, +5 the version (0-5), +10 a u16 attack (Mettaur 10, Mettaur3 160). 120 viruses and 95 Navi records.
